name: reviewer-is-distributed-not-generated
body:
The `implementation-phase-reviewer` is a generic distributed opencode-suite hidden subagent — installed by `apg init` into `~/.config/opencode/agents/` — rather than a repo-local agent the `agent-builder` generates into a project's `.opencode/agents/`. The reviewer runs zero gates and holds zero repo-specific build grants (its work is repo-agnostic structural review), so per-repo generation duplicates effort. The distributed agent set holds seven members.

Distribution surfaces:
1. `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` — the generic template, derived from the repo's own consumer artifact `.opencode/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` (that file is a consumer artifact and sits outside this requirement). Frontmatter: a generic `description:`, `mode: subagent`, and `hidden: true`. Grants: the read-only apg suite (`apg_query`, `apg_find_symbol`, `apg_modules`, `apg_module_files`, `apg_module_structs`, `apg_file_units`, `apg_file_path`, `apg_methods`, `apg_struct`, `apg_callers`, `apg_callees`, `apg_uses`, `apg_unresolved`, `apg_hunk`), the plan read tools (`apg_plan`, `apg_plan_phases`, `apg_plan_tasks`), and `apg_review` / `apg_review_add` / `apg_review_resolve` / `apg_review_reject` + `apg_plan_complete`. The grants exclude `question`, edit, scan, `apg_plan_done`/`apg_plan_undone`/`apg_plan_note`, spec/plan authoring (`apg_node`/`apg_edge`/`apg_plan_add`), and `apg_plan_render`. It carries the common distributed-reviewer shape: the positive read-guard rule ("graph state is reached only through the apg tools" / node and transient files "read only via the tools"), stop-and-report tool-failure prose, and the closed writer↔reviewer cycle prose (it leaves feedback actioning to the coordinator).
2. `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` offers and generates the reviewer zero times: its `description:`, its roster intro, its coordinator section, and its workflow step 4 omit it. The template's statements elsewhere about scaffolding the reviewer — the verify checks and the common-shape note on the reviewer's grant discipline — carry zero reviewer scaffold reference.
3. `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`: its `### Codebase agents` section and its dispatch paragraph describe `implementation-phase-reviewer` as part of the DISTRIBUTED set `apg init` installs, rather than an agent the `agent-builder` generates into `.opencode/agents/`. Its `subagent`-action rule names it as a dispatch target.
4. `src/install.rs` (`rust.apg.install`): the `AGENTS` table carries `("implementation-phase-reviewer.md", include_str!("../opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md"))` and `KNOWN_AGENT_FILES` carries `"implementation-phase-reviewer.md"`; the distributed-agents doc comments read seven.
5. `src/lib.rs` (`rust.apg.main`): the distributed-agents (`AGENTS`) doc comment reads seven.
6. `AGENTS.md`: the distributed-agent count reads seven plus the reviewer name; the reviewer sits among the distributed agents `apg init` installs (only `*-implementer` agents are generated).
7. `README.md`: the distributed-agent count reads seven plus the reviewer name.
8. `tests/main_e2e.rs` (e2e tier): `installed_agent_prompts_state_file_access_read_guard` and `acceptance_node_edge_surface_is_transparent_and_pinned_in_help_tools_and_agents` include `implementation-phase-reviewer.md`.

Acceptance criteria:
- `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` exists, carries `mode: subagent` + `hidden: true`, is generic (free of repo-specific prose), states the positive read-guard rule and stop-and-report, and carries exactly the grant set above (`question`, edit, scan, done/undone/note, authoring, and `apg_plan_render` excluded).
- `apg init` embeds and installs it into `~/.config/opencode/agents/`; every distributed-agent count reads seven (the install doc comments, `src/lib.rs`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`).
- The agent-builder template lists and generates it zero times; the navigator template describes it as distributed; the navigator's `subagent` dispatch rule names it as a target.
- The two named coherence tests include it; `.opencode/agents/**` sit outside this requirement.
- The owning component `solution.component.distributed-reviewer-prompt` carries the `implemented-by` edges to `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` and to `rust.main_e2e.e2e.installed_agent_prompts_state_file_access_read_guard`, per `solution.note.distributed-reviewer-deferred-edge`.
